vibe_rationale: Hot-rod and classic-car community with real roots, but a very large civic festival with an auto-parts naming sponsor, so mass-market leaning.
fit_notes: Huge mixed-age crowd that skews older, a reach play rather than a youth culture one with a weak wellness link. Repco holds the naming slot, so access is closed, though consumer brands already run content here; it is a New Zealand event.
